title: Paper Tide
summary: A digital illustration of layered paper planes and soft light — movement held in a quiet register.
fullDescription: Paper Tide treats layers as weather. Soft planes overlap without collision, suggesting motion through alignment and tonal shift rather than dramatic contrast.
narrative: The illustration began with the feeling of pages turning slowly — motion you notice only after you have already paused.

story.idea: Suggest current and drift using layered planes instead of literal water or wind.
story.inspiration: Stacked paper on a drafting table, translucent envelopes, and late-afternoon studio light.
story.process: Built the image as overlapping veils, adjusting opacity until movement appeared without aggression.

processSteps.title: Layer studies
processSteps.description: Arranged translucent planes to find a rhythm that felt like tide rather than stack.

processSteps.title: Light tuning
processSteps.description: Softened edges and tonal steps so motion read as atmosphere, not outline.

processSteps.title: Final hush
processSteps.description: Reduced contrast until the illustration held a quiet, continuous drift.

story.challenges: Keeping the layers readable without flattening into decoration or rising into noise.
story.reflection: Movement can be gentle and still decisive when every plane has a reason to exist.

seo.metaDescription: A digital illustration of layered paper planes and soft light by Rodge Andru.
